        center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
        print(f"Red block: rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}, center ({center_r}, {center_c})")
        action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        break
